verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a human-facing online e-filing portal, public status search, and lists of human facilitators and patent agents. Nothing shows a system-to-system channel such as an API, system accounts, transmitter programs or batch-provider enrollment, and the llms.txt probe returned 404. E-filing web forms and facilitator registries are adjacent features, not a documented machine rail with a published enrollment path.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
